body:
## Pull request overview

This PR updates the GLM-MoE-DSA implementation to add a DSA indexer path and a rewritten MLA attention forward pass, alongside a config refactor to support new indexer parameters.

**Changes:**
- Add a single-tensor RoPE helper and introduce a standalone `GlmMoeDsaIndexer` module used by attention.
- Rewrite `GlmMoeDsaAttention.forward()` to apply top-k masking (DSA) and adjust caching/FP8-related behavior.
- Refactor `GlmMoeDsaConfig` to inherit from `PreTrainedConfig` and add indexer-related config fields.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 11 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `src/transformers/models/glm_moe_dsa/modular_glm_moe_dsa.py` | Implements the new RoPE helper, indexer module, and rewrites attention forward + FP8-related init behavior. |
| `src/transformers/models/glm_moe_dsa/modeling_glm_moe_dsa.py` | Generated file reflecting the modular changes. |
| `src/transformers/models/glm_moe_dsa/configuration_glm_moe_dsa.py` | Refactors config and adds indexer parameters (`index_head_dim`, `index_n_heads`, etc.). |
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body: `GlmMoeDsaAttention.forward()` applies RoPE with `interleaved=True` (default) here, ignoring `config.rope_interleave`. Pass `interleaved=self.config.rope_interleave` (or remove the config flag) so configuration and runtime behavior stay consistent.
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body: When `q_lora_rank is None`, this sets `q_resid = None`, but the indexer path later expects a real `[B, S, q_lora_rank]` tensor (it feeds it through `wq_b`). Either compute an appropriate indexer query input for the non-LoRA case or explicitly disallow `q_lora_rank=None` for this model.
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body: `index_head_dim`/`qk_rope_head_dim` are used together in the indexer via `torch.split(..., [qk_rope_head_dim, index_head_dim - qk_rope_head_dim])`; if `index_head_dim < qk_rope_head_dim` this will fail at runtime. Consider validating these constraints (and `index_n_heads > 0`, `index_topk > 0`) in the config init so misconfigurations fail early with a clear error.
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body:
The config docstring lists `index_topk`, `index_head_dim`, and `indexer_rope_interleave`, but it doesn't document the newly added `index_n_heads`. Please add a short description of what `index_n_heads` controls and any constraints.
```suggestion
            Head dimension for the indexer projections (DSA).
        index_n_heads (`int`, *optional*, defaults to 8):
            Number of attention heads used by the indexer projections. Should be a positive integer and is typically
            less than or equal to `num_attention_heads`.
```
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body: The PR introduces a new DSA indexer path and changes attention behavior substantially, but there are no targeted tests covering indexer scoring/top-k selection and its cache interaction across prefill+decode. Since `tests/models/glm_moe_dsa/test_modeling_glm_moe_dsa.py` already exists, please extend it to cover these new behaviors.
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body:
`GlmMoeDsaIndexer` treats `config.q_lora_rank` as an `int` and uses it as `in_features` for `wq_b`. If `q_lora_rank=None`, this will fail at init time. Either validate/enforce `q_lora_rank` in the config or implement an indexer query projection for the non-LoRA path.
```suggestion
        self.q_lora_rank: int | None = config.q_lora_rank

        # Named to match checkpoint: wq_b, wk, k_norm
        q_in_features = self.q_lora_rank if self.q_lora_rank is not None else self.hidden_size
        self.wq_b = nn.Linear(q_in_features, self.n_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
```
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body:
`apply_rotary_pos_emb()` uses `x.view(...).transpose(...).reshape(...)` in the interleaved branch. Call sites pass tensors that are typically non-contiguous (e.g. `query_states` is transposed before splitting), so `view()` will raise a runtime error. Use `reshape()` (or `contiguous()` before `view()`) to make this robust.
```suggestion
        x = x.reshape(*shape[:-1], shape[-1] // 2, 2).transpose(-1, -2).reshape(shape)
```
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body: Same as above: `apply_rotary_pos_emb(...)` is called without `interleaved=self.config.rope_interleave`, so `rope_interleave=False` would be silently ignored.
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body: The indexer keeps a persistent cache in module state (`self._cached_keys`) and updates it via concatenation. This cache is not tied to `past_key_values`/`cache_position`, and won’t automatically reset between independent requests, which can cause incorrect generations and unbounded memory growth. Prefer storing indexer keys inside the `Cache` or resetting based on `cache_position`/sequence starts.
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body: This computes full dense attention scores with `einsum` and bypasses the standard attention-backend selection (FlashAttention/SDPA). In similar GLM code, attention goes through `ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS.get_interface` (e.g. `glm4_moe/modeling_glm4_moe.py:255`). Consider routing through that interface and applying the top-k mask via `attention_mask` to retain optimized backends.
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer

body: Building a dense `index_mask` of shape `[batch, seq_length, total_len]` can be very large for long sequences, and (together with dense attention scores) removes most of the intended efficiency gains of DSA. If the goal is speed/memory, consider a truly sparse attention computation (gather K/V by `topk_indices`) or backend support for sparse masking.
author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
